mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lotto_comment (draw_no, username, content, image_url) VALUES (#{drawNo}, #{username}, #{content}, #{imageUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, username, content, image_url AS imageUrl, is_deleted AS isDeleted, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM lotto_comment WHERE draw_no = #{drawNo} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT id, draw_no AS drawNo, username, content, image_url AS imageUrl, is_deleted AS isDeleted, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM lotto_comment WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE lotto_comment SET content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE lotto_comment SET is_deleted = true, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
